title: 娘子 Lady vs Madam
question: When a named woman is addressed as X娘子 (辛娘子, 樂娘子, 樂屏娘子), do you want 'Lady X' or 'Madam X'? The bare spousal sense of 娘子 stays 'wife' either way.
options: Lady X — corpus majority (70), matches Lady Shangguan / Lady Zhu
Madam X — marks married commoner women; 26 current uses
Wife everywhere — base glossary literal; breaks address lines
recommendation: Lady X: corpus majority (70 vs 26), matches 夫人 = Lady and the base's Lady Shangguan / Lady Zhu; 'Madam' reads Victorian rather than wuxia.
themes: title:娘子 Lady vs Madam
rule: 娘子 as an address = Lady X (Lady Xin, Lady Shangguan); the bare spousal sense stays wife. 小娘子 = Young Lady X.

themes: name:釋明 Shi Ming vs Shiming (Dharma name spacing)
rule: 釋明 = Shi Ming (two words, 釋 is the Buddhist surname); 慧明 = Huiming; compounds follow (Master Shi Ming, Martial Uncle Shi Ming).
